# GoldbachStacks — Goldbach's conjecture as a building problem with prime stacks

**Generated file — do not edit.** Regenerated by `python scripts/graph.py`.

**Status:** proved in Lean · **Diagram:** [Gaps between survivors and between primes](../../GRAPH.md#gaps-between-survivors-and-between-primes)

Original to this project. Each odd prime is a stack two wide with one point sticking up (3 is height 1, 5 height 2, 7 height 3, 11 height 5). Two stacks put together make twice their total height plus 2, so building every pair of stacks reaches the target heights. Proved here: the stacks never leave a gap exactly when Goldbach's conjecture holds, and so does the frontier form (as the stacks arrive in order, every target up to a new stack's height is already built from the stacks before it). These are equivalences only; Goldbach's conjecture itself stays open. Also proved: at the wheel of size 3 every stack above height 1 leaves remainder 0 or 2, never 1, and at any single wheel the surviving stacks, taken in pairs, reach every remainder, so no one wheel can force a gap.

## Claims

<a id="goldbach_iff_odd_goldbach"></a>
### `goldbach_iff_odd_goldbach`

Every even number above 2 is a sum of two primes exactly when every even number from 6 on is a sum of two odd primes.

```lean
/-- **Odd primes are enough.** The usual Goldbach conjecture holds exactly
when every even number from 6 on is a sum of two odd primes. -/
def goldbach_iff_odd_goldbach : Prop := goldbach ↔ odd_goldbach
```

**Rests on:** no other node (Mathlib and the Vocabulary only)

**Proof:** `RNS.GoldbachStacks.goldbach_iff_odd_goldbach_holds` in [`RNSSolutions/GoldbachStacks.lean`](../../RNSSolutions/GoldbachStacks.lean)

<a id="no_gap_iff_odd_goldbach"></a>
### `no_gap_iff_odd_goldbach`

Every target height from 2 on is built from two prime stacks exactly when every even number from 6 on is a sum of two odd primes.

```lean
/-- **Stacks never leave a gap exactly under Goldbach.** Every target from 2
on is built from two stacks exactly when every even number from 6 on is a sum
of two odd primes. -/
def no_gap_iff_odd_goldbach : Prop := no_gap ↔ odd_goldbach
```

**Rests on:** no other node (Mathlib and the Vocabulary only)

**Proof:** `RNS.GoldbachStacks.no_gap_iff_odd_goldbach_holds` in [`RNSSolutions/GoldbachStacks.lean`](../../RNSSolutions/GoldbachStacks.lean)

<a id="frontier_ahead_iff_no_gap"></a>
### `frontier_ahead_iff_no_gap`

The frontier stays ahead of every new stack exactly when the stacks never leave a gap.

```lean
/-- **The frontier form.** The frontier staying ahead of every new stack is
the same as the stacks never leaving a gap. -/
def frontier_ahead_iff_no_gap : Prop := frontier_ahead ↔ no_gap
```

**Rests on:** no other node (Mathlib and the Vocabulary only)

**Proof:** `RNS.GoldbachStacks.frontier_ahead_iff_no_gap_holds` in [`RNSSolutions/GoldbachStacks.lean`](../../RNSSolutions/GoldbachStacks.lean)

The frontier stays ahead of every new stack exactly when every even number above 2 is a sum of two primes.

```lean
/-- **The frontier form is Goldbach's conjecture.** The frontier staying
ahead of every new stack holds exactly when every even number above 2 is a
sum of two primes. -/
def frontier_ahead_iff_goldbach : Prop := frontier_ahead ↔ goldbach
```

<a id="stack_mod_three"></a>
### `stack_mod_three`

Every prime stack taller than 1 has a height leaving remainder 0 or 2 on division by 3, never 1.

```lean
/-- **The wheel of size 3.** Every stack taller than 1 has a height leaving
remainder 0 or 2 on division by 3, never 1 (remainder 1 would make its prime a
multiple of 3). -/
def stack_mod_three : Prop :=
  ∀ h : ℕ, is_stack h → 2 ≤ h → h % 3 ≠ 1
```

**Rests on:** no other node (Mathlib and the Vocabulary only)

**Proof:** `RNS.GoldbachStacks.stack_mod_three_holds` in [`RNSSolutions/GoldbachStacks.lean`](../../RNSSolutions/GoldbachStacks.lean)

<a id="wheel_no_gap"></a>
### `wheel_no_gap`

At any single wheel, the heights whose stacks survive it, taken in pairs, reach every remainder, so no wheel on its own leaves a target unbuilt.

```lean
/-- **No single wheel forces a gap.** For every prime `q` and every remainder
`r` modulo `q`, there are two heights `a` and `b` modulo `q` whose stacks
survive the wheel of size `q` (twice the height plus 1 is not a multiple of
`q`) and whose sum leaves remainder `r`. -/
def wheel_no_gap : Prop :=
  ∀ q : ℕ, q.Prime → ∀ r : ZMod q,
    ∃ a b : ZMod q, 2 * a + 1 ≠ 0 ∧ 2 * b + 1 ≠ 0 ∧ a + b = r
```

**Rests on:** no other node (Mathlib and the Vocabulary only)

**Proof:** `RNS.GoldbachStacks.wheel_no_gap_holds` in [`RNSSolutions/GoldbachStacks.lean`](../../RNSSolutions/GoldbachStacks.lean)
